services.name: Signature Haircut
services.subtitle: Tailored precision skin fade, drop fade, low taper, textured crop, or classic gentleman cut. Includes hot lather neck shave and styling.

services.name: Haircut & Beard Sculpting
services.subtitle: The full gentleman's transformation. Precision fade with seamless beard taper, length debulking, razor cheek/neckline shaping, and beard butter.

services.name: Beard Trim & Hot Towel
services.subtitle: Sculpted beard grooming with hot steaming essential towel, straight razor outline, cheek line definition, and nourishing tonic balm.

services.name: Kid's Precision Cut
services.subtitle: Patient, comfortable master styling for ages 12 & under. Clean skin fade, taper, comb over, or scissor crop with neck feathering.

services.name: Razor Edge Lineup
services.subtitle: Fast refresh between haircuts. Surgical straight razor hairline edging, temples, sideburns, and clean tapered neckline finish.

services.name: VIP Total Experience
services.subtitle: The ultimate ritual. Signature haircut, full beard architecture, organic charcoal exfoliating facial scrub, cooling eye mask, and straight razor finish.

reviews.author: Marcus Rodriguez
reviews.text: Hands down the cleanest skin fade in Vegas. I’ve tried at least 5 different shops in town and nobody blends like Daniel. There's a reason everyone recommends him as the top cut. You walk out feeling like a million bucks.

reviews.author: Andre Lewis
reviews.text: The hot towel straight razor beard treatment with Fidel is pure luxury. He lines up the cheeks and neckline with zero irritation. Co-owners who truly care about the craft.

reviews.author: David Thompson
reviews.role: Visitor from Chicago • Cut by Marco Juarez
reviews.text: Flew into Vegas for a conference and needed a tight haircut. Booked an appointment with Marco Juarez online. 5 minutes from the Strip, super easy parking, and Marco gave me one of the sharpest tapers ever.

reviews.author: Jason Torres
reviews.role: Las Vegas Local • Cut by Polo Juarez
reviews.text: Brought my son in for a fade and got my beard lined up with Polo Juarez. Patient, professional, and razor work was on point. Great vibe in the shop, definitely our new family spot!
